# Where these files came from

The finding in this package rests on what the Wyoming Legislature and the State
of Wyoming published. These files are text extracted from those documents. This
records which document, and how, so that anybody can redo it and diff the
result.

Retrieved 2026-10-20 with curl 8.5.0. PDFs are extracted with `pdftotext` from
poppler 24.02.0, and HTML pages with `h2t.py` below, run by Python 3.12.3.

| File | Source | sha256 of the download |
|---|---|---|
| `ws-title39-ch7.txt` | [Wyoming Statutes title 39, Taxation and Revenue, chapter 7, Income Taxes (compiled title)](https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title39.pdf) | `f5d0b10433ddd2e7b135e3f53a87496f0bd705dcd1981807a70478a6ce338ede` |
| `wyo-gov-about.txt` | [State of Wyoming, About Wyoming](https://www.wyo.gov/about-wyoming) | `69cea1ea1d48c2bc4fbe6f4ed9ad67ac29caddca5c14f97f648dc3d5771838eb` |

## Reproducing them

```bash
curl -L -o title39.pdf https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title39.pdf
pdftotext title39.pdf - | awk '/^CHAPTER 7 - INCOME TAXES$/{f=1} f; /^CHAPTER 8 - /{exit}' > ws-title39-ch7.txt

curl -L -o about.html https://www.wyo.gov/about-wyoming
python3 h2t.py about.html | awk '/does not possess an individual or corporate income tax/{print; exit}' > wyo-gov-about.txt
```

`h2t.py` prints an HTML page's visible text, one block per line:

```python
# h2t.py PAGE [ENCODING]: print an HTML page's visible text, one block per line.
import html.parser, sys

BLOCKS = {"p", "div", "br", "li", "tr", "td", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "section", "article"}

class Text(html.parser.HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.out, self.skip = [], 0
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in ("script", "style", "noscript"):
            self.skip += 1
        if tag in BLOCKS:
            self.out.append("\n")
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in ("script", "style", "noscript") and self.skip:
            self.skip -= 1
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if not self.skip:
            self.out.append(data)

raw = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
p = Text()
p.feed(raw.decode(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "utf-8", errors="replace"))
for line in "".join(p.out).splitlines():
    line = " ".join(line.split())
    if line:
        print(line)
```

The Department of Revenue's pages say nothing about an income tax either way (research/estimated-payments/wy.md), so the finding rests on the statutes and the state's own portal. The compiled title is regenerated by the Legislature, and the portal page's HTML changes between downloads, so a later download of either can differ in its sha256 while the extract stays the same.
